title: taxiframe
summary: Program.Taxi.cs covers the session and the window: eligibility/distance gating, CMSG_TAXINODE_STATUS_QUERY, CMSG_TAXIQUERYNODES, SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES decode (mask -> known nodes), the 384x512 UI-TaxiFrame four-piece shell, the continent TAXIMAP texture in the 316x352 rect, node icons projected from TaxiNodes.dbc, click-to-fly (CMSG_ACTIVATETAXI), name/You-are-here tooltip, SMSG_ACTIVATETAXIREPLY, flight spline playback with input lockout and arrival hand-off, flight-master title text. Concrete Benilla/ref behaviors are absent.

openItems.text: No route lines: the ref/Benilla draw single-hop spokes from the current node plus the full (multi-hop) route on hover via TaxiRouteFrame textures; MSUI draws nothing between nodes
No fare display: ref shows the destination cost (GameTooltip money line); MSUI tooltip has name only
Only two icon states (green current / yellow other): the REACHABLE-white vs DISTANT-yellow distinction is absent
No CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS path (edge-less multi-hop chain activation) and no SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH first-visit learn handling (registry's two missing opcodes)
No ERR_TAXINOPATHS error toast on a no-single-hop-destination refusal
No flight-master portrait on the window's portrait ring
Node placement uses a bespoke bounding-box normalization over the continent's node extents rather than the WorldMapContinent projection - icon positions likely drift from the authored map
